---
title: Multi-file demos
---

An external demo's entry file can import other local files, and the whole
import graph comes along — one editor tab per file:

```tsx file="./snippets/multiFile/MultiFile.tsx" playground

```

Only the entry file is named in the MDX. Tabs are labelled by each file's path
relative to the entry's directory, so `buttons/styles.ts` and `cards/styles.ts`
stay distinct.

The `import` statements _inside_ demo files resolve like your bundler's, and
can be extensionless: `./Button` is tried as `.tsx`, `.ts`, `.jsx`, `.js`, then
`Button/index.*`.
